notes:
Short CRM notes + call snippets:
- Company: customer-support platform used by fintech & marketplaces; heavy ticket volume during peak (seasonal).
- Primary goal: reduce agent handle time / deflect simple tickets with RAG-based assistant. Interested in embedding + reranking pipeline to ensure top-5 answers are high precision.
- Scale: target index ~3-4M documents (tickets, KB articles, transcripts). Avg doc size 1-2KB, canonicalized to 1 embedding per doc + optional chunking for long transcripts.
- Latency SLO: p95 end-to-end search+rerank under 120ms for single-query lookup (frontend timeout 200ms). Cost target: <$0.0008 per query (inclusive of embeddings + reranking cost) to hit unit economics.
- Reranker requirement: neural reranking to improve top-5 relevance; want A/B suite vs lexical baseline and fallback to cheaper model under load.
- Data controls: must support VPC private endpoints, KMS integration, audit logs, and per-customer retention policies. Data residency requirement for EU customers.
- Quote from CTO: "We need reliable top-5 answers within 100-120ms — anything slower kills UX."
- Internal constraints: infra team worried about sustained QPS spikes during product launches; ask for autoscaling + burst protection.
- Next: SE-run index/batch cost sim + latency benchmark on dedicated pool, provide quantization/recommendation from Optimize toolkit.
- Docs shared: security FAQ, preliminary SOW, sample ticket export (anonymized).
use_case_summary: Customer support RAG primarily for ticket deflection and agent assist. Embeddings-index + reranking workflow to surface top-5 high-precision answers, fallback to generative assistant when confidence low. Emphasis on tight latency SLOs and predictable cost per query.
technical_requirements:
- Indexing scale: 3-4M docs; support incremental updates (near real-time).
- Embedding model: prefer open/quantized model options, but will consider hosted embedding API for initial PoC.
- Reranker: model able to run at <50ms for re-ranking candidate set (top-50 -> top-5), supports batching for throughput.
- Throughput target: baseline 200 qps, burst to 1k qps during peaks.
- Observability: per-query token/cost breakdown, latency traces, per-route SLO dashboards.
- Fallbacks: cheaper dense-only search when dedicated capacity constrained; soft limit on monthly vector ops to manage cost.
